editorial.description_en: A chestnut shell after roasting: dark red-brown with the split showing paler.
editorial.description_ja: 焼いた栗の皮のような、濃い赤茶。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.282, C 0.066, h 40.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 焼き (yaki, roasting) + 栗 (kuri, chestnut), rendaku to -guri. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Roasted Chestnut" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 焼栗. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — furu-gawara at ΔE00 5.8, ame-doro at ΔE00 6.9, koi-tsuchi at ΔE00 7.7. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (220°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
